interpretation: Conventional one-neighbor lookup trained on identical prior local observations perfectly restores a recoverable function. Candidate's two-neighbor agreement refuses all predictions and thus does not generalize beyond redundant-concordant neighborhoods. Both preserve abstention on genuinely irrecoverable target. This does not imply that faster or general regeneration is impossible, only that this mechanism is insufficient.
